items.briefing:
A critical vulnerability has been discovered in GitLab that poses a serious risk to software supply chains — if your organisation uses GitLab for code or project management, ensure it is updated immediately. Separately, the Russian hacking group Sandworm has been exploiting vulnerabilities in Cisco network devices to deploy malware, a reminder to keep all network equipment patched and firmware current.

On the AI front, reports suggest that human reviewers may read ChatGPT conversations as part of quality processes — staff should avoid sharing sensitive or confidential work information through AI chat tools. **Practical tip:** Treat AI chat platforms like a public forum — never paste in client data, student records, or internal documents.
